text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, magnesium sulfate 40 mg/mL 50 mL bags are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 336 bags (27.5 days at 12.2 bags/day). Corvale General holds 235 bags (17.6 days at 13.4 bags/day). Supply is limited but not officially short.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows magnesium sulfate is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 17.6 to 27.5 days. No FDA shortage declaration exists. Proactive sourcing is warranted to prevent stockouts at Corvale General first.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places immediate orders with B. Braun Medical Inc. for both campuses; Pharmacy Director approves purchase.
2. Buyer places backup orders with Civica, Inc. (supplied by Baxter Healthcare Corporation Deerfield); Pharmacy Director approves purchase.
3. Buyer evaluates Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (supplied by HP Halden Pharma AS, last inspected VAI 2023-05-10) and Hospira, Inc. (last inspected NAI 2025-02-07) for additional volume; Pharmacy Director approves purchase.
4. Buyer monitors Athenex Pharmaceutical Division, LLC availability; Pharmacy Director approves if vetted.
5. Buyer reports weekly inventory and days-on-hand to P&T Committee until both sites exceed 30 days; P&T Committee Chair acknowledges report.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or rationing at this time.
